buttons.ghost: hover:bg-white/5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white px-3 py-2 rounded-md transition-all

cards.base: bg-slate-900/40 border border-white/10 rounded-xl backdrop-blur-sm overflow-hidden

phase_1_header_redesign.objective: Create a 'Control Room' header with clear status and controls
changes: Move 'Config Summary' to a dedicated HUD strip below the title or integrated into the top bar.
Redesign 'Continuous Mode' toggle as a prominent Segmented Control or Switch.
Ensure 'Start/Stop' buttons are visually distinct and separated from configuration toggles.
Wrap the main content in a `grid-cols-12` container.
Place Metrics Cards in the top row (spanning full width).
Place Equity Charts in a `col-span-8` container.
Place Open Positions/Trades in a `col-span-4` side panel.
Ensure all panels have consistent height and spacing.
Add subtle glow effects to active states (Continuous Mode ON, Live Status).
Use 'Glassmorphism' for the header and floating panels.

continuous_mode_toggle.location: Right side of header, before Start button

config_hud.location: Inline with header or immediately below title

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors with subtle noise if needed.
Ensure all interactive elements have a hover state.
Maintain high contrast for text (WCAG AA).
